name: ManyChat
summary: Comment-to-DM and chat funnels for Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp and SMS. Flows are button-and-script based, so an unexpected reply falls back.
best_for: creators and brands running comment-to-DM and multi-channel (Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp) marketing funnels: its killer feature works reliably
skip_if: you want true conversational AI support, or you have a fast-growing contact list: the flow logic is rigid and contact-based billing climbs fast
honest_knock: Flows are button-and-script based, not natural language: type something unexpected and the bot falls back. The AI add-on is closer to keyword-matching than real conversational AI, billing scales with contacts (a viral Reel can spike your bill), and support is email-only and slow.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per month, or $14/mo billed annually, at 250 contacts
pricing.notes: Read on their own pricing page, 6 September 2026, and again, unchanged, 25 September 2026. Free: $0, 25 active contacts, 2 channels, 1 user. Paid tiers are banded by active contacts and priced two ways — month to month, or the lower rate if you pay for the year. Essential $17/mo or $14/mo billed annually ($168, 18% off), 250 contacts, 2 channels, 2 users. Pro $39/mo or $29 annually ($348, 25% off), 2,500 contacts, 3 channels, 3 users. Business $99/mo or $69 annually ($828, 30% off), 7,500 contacts, unlimited channels, 5 users. Advanced $199/mo or $139 annually ($1,668, 30% off), 25,000 contacts, unlimited channels, 10 users. Going over your allowance does not stop your automations: each extra active contact is billed at $0.10, $0.05, $0.025 and $0.004 on monthly billing, or $0.082, $0.038, $0.018 and $0.0028 on annual. Essential and Pro carry a 14-day free trial.

schema_offer.description: 250 active contacts, per month; billed on active contacts, meaning anyone who sends or receives a message through ManyChat in the monthly billing period. Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-09-25.
